name: Umbrel (umbrelOS)
description: Umbrel’s inspected update bootstrap delegates device-specific updates to Mender or Rugix, with a legacy compatibility branch. The original direct shell-execution description and a complete bundle-authentication classification remain unsubstantiated by this snapshot.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; Mender/Rugix internals, artifact signatures, server-side manifests, and older umbrelOS update scripts were not independently audited.
